label: Poll

privacy.named: The host sees who votes for what, and names are saved.
privacy.namedStage: Who voted for what is saved, not shown here

changeHint: You can change your vote until the host closes the poll.
waitingForHost: Waiting for the host to continue

arrival.playerNote: Your name shows on the screen when you vote. Your choice does not.
arrival.playerNoteLive: Your name shows on the screen when you vote, and the results update live, so the room may see what you picked.

vote.failed: Your vote did not go through. Try again.
vote.tooManyChanges: You have changed your vote too many times.

host.sealedNote: Results appear when the poll is closed.

launcher.title: Run a poll
launcher.empty: No polls yet. Create one in the Polls tab.

outcome.busy: A question or another poll is showing. Try again when it is done.
outcome.notFound: That poll could not be found. It may have been deleted.
outcome.notManager: Only the host can run polls.
outcome.invalid: The poll could not be started: it is not valid.
outcome.noAck: The server did not answer. Try again.
outcome.none: Nothing to do: the poll was already closed.
outcome.alreadyRan: That poll has already run in this room.
outcome.full: This room has run as many polls as it can keep.
outcome.notCurrent: That poll is no longer on the screen.

editor.questionPlaceholder: What do you want to ask the room?
editor.optionsHint: Two to six options. Everyone in the room votes on one of them.
editor.anonymousOn: Nobody sees who voted for what, and no names are saved.
editor.anonymousOff: You see each player's name next to their vote, names show on the screen as people vote, and players are told.
editor.liveOff: The screen shows each name as people vote, and how many have voted. The results appear when you close the poll.
editor.liveOn: The screen shows the results as votes come in, with names only in a named poll. In a small group, watching the counts can still hint at who voted what.
editor.fitWarning: May not fit the projector. Shorten the question or the options.

unsaved.title: Discard unsaved changes?
unsaved.description: Your edits to this poll have not been saved.

result.partialNote: The room closed while this poll was still open, so these are the votes up to that moment.
result.subject: In {{subject}}
